final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.healtheval, SUM(sc.scancount) as sum_scancount, AVG(CAST(sc.gbsize AS REAL) / sc.spanmin) as avg_ratio FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_avg FROM step1) SELECT step1.healtheval, step1.sum_scancount, step1.avg_ratio, step1.avg_ratio - step2.avg_of_avg FROM step1, step2 WHERE step2.avg_of_avg IS NOT NULL AND step1.avg_ratio > step2.avg_of_avg
